annotations.title: Trench drain grate load class picker (EN 1433)

description: The EN 1433 load class, A 15 to F 900, and its test load in kN for where a trench drain goes and what drives or rolls over it.

application.description: footpath = Footpath, patio, pool deck or cycle path; domestic-driveway = Domestic driveway (cars and light vans); private-road = Private road or slow residential lane; public-space = Public space or plaza with light vehicles; car-park = Car park (slow, light vehicles); retail-parking = Supermarket or retail parking lot; petrol-forecourt = Petrol station forecourt (fuel delivery trucks cross it); vans-light-trucks = Vans and light trucks up to 7.5 t; public-road-trucks = Public road, carriageway or commercial driveway with trucks; logistics-bus = Logistics area or bus station; industrial-forklift = Industrial yard or loading dock apron with forklifts; port-airport = Container terminal, port, airport or aircraft apron. If more than one applies, pick the heaviest.

name: trench_drain_grate_load_class
